summary: The Phase 4 Task 1 production commit b6824b8a keeps the Workbooks list read only and adds no write path into the Workbooks tree. The stage check confines every spec reference to out/ or docs/ and refuses an absolute path, a '..' segment, a symbolic link, and a real path outside the realpath of the repository root. The check writes no file. The live week 2 gate exits 0 with the v4 pin and 82 element paths. The deliver week filter refuses an approval entry of another week before the first mkdir, so a refused run leaves no file. No shell string comes from a CLI argument, and no key or token reaches a log. The four test files pass 172 of 172 tests. Six nonblocking findings remain. They cover the fixture pin seam, the unconfined --specs folder, the unpinned deliver list, the approval-entry-only publish gate, one stale contract line, and one log line that takes the list row id without a pattern.
nonblocking_findings: RB10-01 Nit fixture seam: the stage check accepts --list-sha256 on every run (scripts/storytime-stage-check.mjs:45, 58, 61). The flag replaces the pin, and the pass output prints no override line. A production run can pass a modified list when the caller supplies its hash. The header (line 14) and tests/storytime-stage-check.test.ts call the flag test-only, and no code enforces that. The content checks still run, so a modified list must match 27 spec ids and the exact spec text and goal. The practical impact is small; the gap is the missing record that the pin was overridden. An override line in the label block or an environment guard would close it. (code reading; confirmed; a wrong hash exits 2 in a live run)

RB10-02 Nit unconfined inputs: the stage check confines spec references only. It resolves --specs and --list against the working directory and reads any folder the caller names (scripts/storytime-stage-check.mjs:112, 130). The tool writes nothing, so the impact is a read of JSON files. The reference rule holds at lines 74 to 84: out/ or docs/ only, no '..' segment, no symbolic link, and a realpath compare. The live week 2 run checked 82 references with 0 missing and 0 escapes. (code reading and live run; confirmed)

RB10-03 Nit unpinned deliver list: the deliver command reads the picture list with no expected SHA-256 (src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:4732). The approval list pin pictureListSha256 is optional (src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts:76). A delivery can run with no list binding; the manifest records the measured hash only. The new --week filter (line 4745) widens the effect: a foreign list selects one week and skips the rest. The week 1 approved.json does carry the v4 pin, so the gap is enforcement, not a live defect. test-strategy.md 4.2 forbids a second pin in the deliver path, so a fix belongs in the approval schema. This repeats RB9-03. (code reading; confirmed)

RB10-04 Nit approval-entry-only gate: the writer accepts an approval entry with no reviews field (src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts:63-71, 233). T181 uses such entries and delivers 27 rows. A picture with no model review and no person review can reach the delivery. test-strategy.md 4.5 says 'Only clean rows go into the manifest (contract decision 2)'. The code refuses a fail verdict only when a review is present. The week 1 approved.json holds a kimi review per entry, so the gap is enforcement. A2 holds in the narrow sense: the approval entry is the human artifact, and no test flips a draft to a published state. (code reading; confirmed)

RB10-05 Nit stale contract line: contract.md line 6 still says 'Picture list version 3 is the source of the week 1 rows'. Line 9 names version 4. Task 1 wrote the v4 bullet and left the header sentence. A11 covers this drift. The code pin is correct (src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:3568) and equals the live list. (code reading; confirmed)

RB10-06 Nit log value: the deliver skip line prints the row id from the list without a pattern check (src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:4752; the id schema is z.string().min(1) at line 1499). A list row id that holds a newline forges a log line. The impact is one log line; the manifest JSON escapes the value. The list is read only and pinned for render and verify; the deliver path has no pin (RB10-03). (code reading; confirmed)
evidence: Provenance: git rev-parse HEAD returned 4d4d86a26def246195d7ad022c3dcbafd4ca965d, the audited HEAD. No commit followed it. The working tree holds uncommitted edits in other tracks only; every read in scope used git show 4d4d86a2:<path>. phase_base_sha fc76c27209402c54354447693e9b291d4411ff79 is the orchestrator value. role_base_sha equals the audited HEAD.

Scope: production b6824b8a changes src/storytime/book-pictures.ts (+22 lines), adds scripts/storytime-stage-check.mjs (239 lines), and changes contract.md (10 lines). Red c0035c28 adds T173 to T182. c2ebc72d fixes the T173 and T177 fixture paths.

Gate: bash heavy-run.sh -c 'vitest run tests/storytime-stage-check.test.ts --maxWorkers=1' gave Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 3 passed (3), Duration 2.07s, exit 0. The muse-delivery file gave 23 passed (23), Duration 33.80s, exit 0. The book-pictures and picture-rows files gave 2 files and 146 passed (146), Duration 267.73s, exit 0. No exit 75 and no skip.

Live staging gate: node scripts/storytime-stage-check.mjs --week 2 --list /home/daniebo/Desktop/Workbooks/content/storytime/l2/print/pictures.json --specs docs/storytime/l2-unit1/w02/muse printed list sha256 6d05dfc596c7f1891577a800a9375228136acc332c7c8b975c9df0bf6c062a58, week 2, rows 27, specs found 27, text mismatches 0, goal mismatches 0, outDir mismatches 0, rows with no reference 0, element paths checked 82, missing element paths 0, characters without a reference 0, page candidates 0, stage check pass, exit 0. The code pin equals the live list. The 82 references resolve inside out/ or docs/.
Pin refusal: the same command with --list-sha256 0000...0000 printed 'stage check: fail (the picture list changed)' and exited 2. The pin path works.

Read boundary: loadPictureList calls readFileSync on the list and never writes (src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:1522-1537). The deliver path and the render path both call it. No command in the commit writes under the Workbooks tree. The module imports no network call.

Stage check reads: referenceProblem rejects a non-string, an absolute path, a '..' segment, and a first segment other than out or docs (lines 68-74). It calls lstat, refuses a symbolic link and a non-file, compares realpath(absolute) with path.join(realRoot, ...segments), refuses an empty file, and reads the PNG signature through an 'r' handle (lines 76-92). The script holds no mkdir, writeFile, or child process.
Stage check writes: none. The only handle opens with 'r'. main() calls process.exit with 0, 1, or 2.

Argument parsing: the stage check takes flag and value pairs, refuses an unknown flag, a missing value, and a value that starts with '--' (lines 44-56). --week is an integer from 1 to 8 (line 52). --list-sha256 must be 64 lower-case hexadecimal characters (line 58). book-pictures.ts parseWeek accepts 1 to 8 and refuses a fraction, 0, and 9 (lines 4618-4622).

Deliver refusal: writeMuseDelivery validates the approval list, a repeated rowId, an unknown rowId, the list pin, the line-art names, the duplicates, and every print byte before mkdir (src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts:312-401). The unknown-rowId error at line 315 stops a week 3 entry in a week 2 run before the mkdir at line 445. T182 asserts that the refused delivery folder holds no file (tests/storytime-muse-delivery.test.ts:1082-1113).
No partial file: the copies use the wx flag, and the writer collects every problem before the first write (line 401, 'nothing was written'). An identical manifest is skipped.

Shell: scripts/storytime-book-pictures.ts passes each argument as one array element to spawnSync ('bash', [HEAVY_RUN, process.execPath, '--import', 'tsx', script, ...argv]). No shell string is built from a CLI argument. The stage check spawns nothing.

Secrets: src/storytime/book-pictures.ts imports no network call and no credential; secretFindings and redactSecrets remove a bearer token and an environment value. The CLI error boundary redacts and truncates to REDACTED_ERROR_MAX_CHARS. The OpenRouter key is read only by scripts/storytime-muse.mjs, which the stage check and the deliver path do not import. I opened no .env.local file.

Sensitive data: the stage check prints counts and the list hash. The deliver log prints the list path and hash and the skip lines. The manifest holds row text and prompt from the list, the review fields, and the reviewer name. None of these holds a key, a token, or a credential.

Test isolation: tests/storytime-stage-check.test.ts builds every fixture with mkdtemp(os.tmpdir()) and removes it in afterEach (lines 147, 235). The T180 case copies the v3 shadow bytes from /tmp/opencode into the fixture list. c2ebc72d moved the T173 stage file into its temporary root. After the four test runs, git status --porcelain docs/storytime/ out/storytime/ printed nothing, so no test left a file there.
A2: not triggered. No test flips a draft to a published state. The delivery gate requires an approval entry per row; see RB10-04 for the review-field gap.
A6: measure/tracks.md at 4d4d86a2 lists the track as [~] with no security-resolved claim (lines 138-139). The plan quotes commands and labeled values. contract.md line 6 is stale; see RB10-05.
The task adds no endpoint, authentication boundary, tenant or organization scope, migration, or secret store.
Probe limit: the shell tool refused a listing and a hash of /tmp/opencode/wb-shadow. RB10-01 rests on code reading plus the two live runs above. No probe wrote a file.

handoff: Verdict is pass. b6824b8a keeps the Workbooks list read only, the stage check confines spec references to out/ and docs/ with a realpath compare, and the week delivery refuses a wrong-week entry before any write. The four test files pass 172 of 172 tests, and the live week 2 gate exits 0 with the v4 pin and 82 element paths. Six nonblocking findings go to Green: RB10-01 (Nit, the --list-sha256 seam is unguarded and prints no override line), RB10-02 (Nit, --specs and --list are unconfined), RB10-03 (Nit, the deliver list has no pin; repeats RB9-03), RB10-04 (Nit, an approval entry with no review delivers), RB10-05 (Nit, contract.md line 6 still names version 3), RB10-06 (Nit, the skip line prints an unchecked list row id). No product decision is required.
